label: The longer ending of Mark
note: Missing from the two oldest complete Greek manuscripts. Most modern Bibles print it with a note.

label: The woman caught in adultery
note: Missing from the earliest Greek manuscripts of John. Most modern Bibles print it with a note.

label: The Comma Johanneum
note: The Trinitarian wording of verse 7 stands in the Textus Receptus but not in early Greek manuscripts.

label: The eunuch's confession
note: In the Textus Receptus, and missing from the Byzantine and critical editions.

label: The doxology of the Lord's Prayer
note: "For yours is the kingdom" is in the traditional text but not in the oldest manuscripts.

label: This kind goes out by prayer and fasting
note: In the traditional text, and left out of the critical editions.

label: The Son of Man came to save the lost
note: In the traditional text, and left out of the critical editions.

label: If anyone has ears to hear
note: In the traditional text, and left out of the critical editions.

label: Where their worm does not die
note: Verses 44 and 46 repeat verse 48 in the traditional text.

label: If you do not forgive
note: In the traditional text, and left out of the critical editions.

label: He was numbered with the transgressors
note: In the traditional text, and left out of the critical editions.

label: The angel and the bloody sweat
note: Early manuscripts divide over these verses. Critical editions print them in double brackets.

label: Father, forgive them
note: Early manuscripts divide over this saying.

label: The only God or the only Son
note: A difference of one word with theological interest, which affects the title given to Christ.

label: The angel stirring the water
note: In the traditional text, and left out of the critical editions.

label: The church of God or of the Lord
note: Manuscripts and editions differ over this title.

label: The grace of our Lord
note: In the traditional text, and left out of the critical editions.

label: God or He who was manifested
note: A difference of one word with theological interest.

label: The book or the tree of life
note: The Textus Receptus here follows a reading with very little Greek support.
